mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand and business investment, which drive corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 1% from the previous month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high manufacturing activity (INDPRO above 105) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 5.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing production (INDPRO) exceeds 105, it signals robust industrial activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1% from the previous month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.25% in the last month), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher levels of housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity, which correlates with robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
